metaDescription: Boilermaker or welder? Get your MEM31925 Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade (replaces MEM31922) through RPL. Free eligibility check.
heroIntro: The MEM31925 Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade is the trade qualification for boilermakers, welders and metal fabricators. It replaces MEM31922. If you've been fabricating and welding for years, RPL turns that experience into your trade papers.
whoIsItFor:
• Boilermakers and welders without a formal trade qualification
  • Metal fabricators and sheet metal workers
  • Structural steel fabricators
  • Overseas-trained boilermakers and welders

Candidates usually have several years of fabrication work: reading drawings, marking out, cutting, forming and welding using a range of processes (MIG, TIG, stick, flux-cored). There are boilermaking, welding, sheetmetal, blacksmithing and surface finishing specialisations.
evidenceExamples:
• Photos and videos of your welds and fabrications
  • Drawings you've worked from
  • Weld test certificates or welding tickets
  • A reference from a qualified tradesperson or workshop manager
  • Payslips or a statement of service
  • Overseas trade certificates

A practical assessment, including welding to a standard, is part of the process.
licensingInfo: Fabrication and welding aren't licensed trades, but some work (for example pressure vessels or structural steel to certain standards) requires welders to hold specific qualifications or welding certifications. Check the requirements for the work you do.
description: The MEM31925 Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade covers the work of fabrication tradespeople: interpreting technical drawings, measuring and marking out, cutting and shaping materials, welding using a range of processes, and assembling fabricated components. It uses a points system, with specialisations in boilermaking, welding, sheetmetal, blacksmithing and surface finishing.

faqs.a: MEM31922 has been superseded by MEM31925 Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade. If you already hold MEM31922 it stays valid. New enrolments and RPL are in MEM31925.

faqs.q: Can I get my boilermaker or welder trade papers through RPL?
faqs.a: Yes, if you have fabrication and welding experience. Your evidence and a practical assessment are assessed against the units.
Usually 4 to 6 weeks.
It depends on your evidence. Start with a free eligibility check.
Yes, overseas fabrication experience is assessed against the same national units.

metaTitle: CPP20218 Cert II Security Operations — Security Licence
metaDescription: Get your CPP20218 Certificate II in Security Operations, the training for a security officer licence. Check what your state allows. Free eligibility check.
heroIntro: The CPP20218 Certificate II in Security Operations is the entry qualification for security officers and crowd controllers. It's the training most states require before you can apply for a security licence.
whoIsItFor:
• People starting out as security officers or guards
  • Crowd controllers and event security staff
  • Licensed officers moving to another state
  • Overseas-trained security workers
evidenceExamples:
• Any existing security licence (from any state)
  • A statement of service from a security employer
  • Incident reports and patrol logs (de-identified)
  • First aid certificate
licensingInfo:
Security licences are issued by state and territory regulators, often the police. Examples include the NSW Police Security Licensing and Enforcement Directorate, Victoria Police Licensing and Regulation Division, and the Office of Fair Trading in Queensland. Regulators set strict rules on approved training, and some restrict whether RPL can be used for licence training.

Before you start, tell us your state. We'll confirm what the regulator accepts, including whether RPL is allowed, so you don't pay for training that can't be used for your licence.
description: The CPP20218 Certificate II in Security Operations covers the skills of front-line security officers: communicating effectively, working within the law, managing conflict and responding to security risks, patrolling, controlling access, and responding to emergencies.

faqs.q: Can I get CPP20218 through RPL?
faqs.a: It depends on your state. Security regulators set strict rules on licence training, and some don't accept RPL. We'll confirm what applies where you live before you start.

faqs.q: Does this get me a security licence?
faqs.a: It's the training most states require for a security officer licence. You then apply to your state regulator, which also does probity checks.
Some theory may be online, but security licence training usually requires in-person assessment.

faqs.q: What's the next step after Cert II?
faqs.a: Supervisors and patrol officers often go on to the CPP31318 Certificate III in Security Operations.

faqs.q: Is a CPP20218 gained through RPL the same as studying it?
faqs.a: Yes. It is the same nationally recognised CPP20218 Certificate II in Security Operations, issued by a registered training organisation. Your certificate and transcript don’t say whether you got it through RPL or by studying.

metaTitle: CPP41419 Cert IV Real Estate Practice RPL — Online
metaDescription: Working in real estate? Get your CPP41419 Certificate IV in Real Estate Practice through RPL, the agent licence pathway. Free eligibility check.
heroIntro: The CPP41419 Certificate IV in Real Estate Practice is the qualification for a real estate agent's licence in most states. If you're already working in sales, property management or as an agent's representative, RPL recognises that experience online.
whoIsItFor:
• Sales agents and agent's representatives
  • Property managers
  • Buyer's agents, auctioneers and business brokers
  • Agents who want a full licence

Candidates usually have a couple of years of real estate work including listing, selling or leasing property, managing trust accounting procedures and following property laws.
evidenceExamples:
• Agency agreements, appraisals and marketing campaigns you've prepared (de-identified)
  • Leasing or property management records
  • Your current registration or certificate of registration

licensingInfo:
Real estate licences are issued by state and territory regulators, such as NSW Fair Trading, Consumer Affairs Victoria and the Office of Fair Trading in Queensland. In most states the Certificate IV (or specified units from it) is the education requirement for a full agent licence. Each state specifies the units it requires. Tell us your state and we'll make sure the electives match.
description: The CPP41419 Certificate IV in Real Estate Practice covers the work of real estate professionals: property sales and leasing, property management, appraisals, marketing, trust accounting, ethics and property law.
